html:
SMTO-SCH-0029 — The Agent changed the reminder message you asked for

GUID: 22e433b6-3f28-456a-89a5-cbcf543e6694
Slug: notification-payload-mismatch
Domain: SCH · Subsystem: sch

What happened

  • You asked SMTO to remind you later with a certain message, but the Agent tried to save a different or missing message. SMTO stopped it before the reminder was saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Keep the conversation open. The Agent is told to use your exact reminder text. The reminder should say what you asked for, not a summary the Agent made up.
  2. Open Schedules, select Edit on the reminder, and check that Type is Reminder only and the Reminder text is your message. This is the message you will receive when the reminder goes off.
  3. If the reminder isn't there, select New schedule, set Type to Reminder only, type your message in Reminder text, set the time, then select Create schedule. Setting it up yourself saves the message exactly as you type it.

What success looks like

  • One reminder appears on the Schedules page with your message and the right Next run time.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't turn off the Enforce temporal routing check to get past this; it could make the Agent act at the wrong time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Temporal routing rejected schedule.create because the notification_message is missing, differs from the requested deferred message, or the notification fields are incompatible.

What this means

  • After other temporal fields match, notification validation finds a different/missing delivered message or incompatible notification payload. Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.

Why this can happen

  • After other temporal fields match, notification validation finds a different/missing delivered message or incompatible notification payload.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare expected_notification_message with the actual notification_message field.

How to fix it

  • After the other temporal fields matched, _notification_matches failed: notification_message (or prompt when it is absent) did not equal the route's deferred_notification after normalizing case, whitespace and trailing punctuation. Copy expected_notification_message into notification_message; do not substitute a summary or another instruction.
  • Use the captured expected notification message in the supported notification_message field. Do not replace the requested content with a summary or different instruction.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported notification schedule delivers the captured intended message.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
